text: dsh-inkscreen-theme 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的墨水纸与毛玻璃风格主题。它通过客户端模块注入 CSS、调整聊天区字体与面板外观，并替换侧栏品牌标识。主要功能包括最近会话标签及状态提示、点击切换会话、Conversation/Trace 视图切换的紧凑排版，以及手写字样和头像。适合希望让 DSH 网页聊天界面更具编辑感并快速切换近期会话的用户。侧栏字样会加载 Google Fonts 的 Caveat 字体；没有额外密钥或账号配置。

dsh-inkscreen-theme gives the DSH web chat an ink-and-paper look with frosted panels and editorial typography. It replaces the sidebar brand, adds recent-session tabs with status dots and click-to-open navigation, and restyles the Conversation/Trace switch. Caveat font loads from Google Fonts.
想把 DSH 网页聊天换成温暖的墨水纸和毛玻璃风格。
有没有能调整 DSH 聊天界面字体、输入框和面板外观的主题？
我想在会话标题栏看到最近打开的对话并快速切换。
能不能在最近会话旁边显示运行中或等待输入的状态？
让 DSH 网页的侧栏品牌显示手写字样和头像。
想把 Conversation 和 Trace 的视图切换控件排得更紧凑。
I want a warm editorial theme for the DSH web chat.
Show my recent DSH conversations as tabs with live status dots.
dsh-inkscreen-theme 的功能「墨水纸界面主题」：为聊天区域注入浅色、暖色调和毛玻璃样式，并调整对话文字、标题及代码字体。插件加载时自动应用样式。
dsh-inkscreen-theme 的功能「最近会话标签」：在聊天标题区域列出最多六个可见的近期会话，显示运行、等待、完成或空闲状态；点击标签即可打开对应会话。
dsh-inkscreen-theme 的功能「侧栏品牌替换」：监视侧栏品牌节点，并将其内容替换为 jimmy 手写字样和内嵌头像；窄区域会使用紧凑样式。
dsh-inkscreen-theme 的功能「视图切换排版」：把 DSH 内置的 Conversation/Trace 标签移动到最近会话栏，并应用紧凑分段控件样式。
dsh-inkscreen-theme 使用前须知：侧栏手写字样会从 fonts.googleapis.com 请求 Caveat 字体；字体无法加载时 CSS 会回退到系统手写字体。 （见 lib/client.js:13,131）

dsh-inkscreen-theme README · dsh-inkscreen-theme：An ink-and-paper, Apple-glass theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) web client (`dsh web`).

It restyles the chat shell with soft frosted-glass panels, warm cream/ink colors,
an editorial Kai/handwritten voice for conversation text, and crisp monospace
code. It also replaces the sidebar brand mark with a handwritten **"jimmy"**
wordmark next to a small dog avatar. The visual system intentionally focuses on
one polished light ink-and-paper appearance.

dsh-inkscreen-theme README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-inkscreen-theme
```

or add it to your profile's `package.json` as a `file:`/npm dependency and list
it in `dsh.profile.bundles`, then restart `dsh web` (this plugin changes package
identity/CSS injected at boot, so a hot-reload is not enough).

dsh-inkscreen-theme README · What it does：- Injects a `<style>` block with e-ink/Apple-glass CSS variables and rules for
  the sidebar, dialogs, composer, code blocks, and scrollbars.
- Keeps a consistent light ink-and-paper appearance with warm accents and
  restrained Apple-style translucency.
- Gives Chinese conversation text a readable Kai-style editorial voice,
  expressive handwritten headings, and preserves monospace for code.
- Adds a compact recent-conversation tab rail above the chat, with live status
  dots for running, waiting-for-input, completed, and idle sessions; clicking a
  tab switches directly to that conversation.
- Places the built-in **Conversation / Trace** view switch on the same header
  row, styled as a compact segmented control for quick context switching.
- Watches the sidebar brand element and replaces its content with a
  handwritten wordmark (`Caveat` webfont, falling back to a system cursive
  font) plus a small rounded-square dog avatar image.

dsh-inkscreen-theme README · Personalization note：The wordmark text ("jimmy") and the avatar image are hard-coded — this is a
personal theme, not a generic template. If you want your own name/avatar,
fork the repo and edit the `name`/`DOG_LOGO` constants near the top of
`lib/client.js`.
